nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Go on. The dark has nothing on you.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: The dummy, little scribble. Click, or J. It won't hit back. That's the whole appeal.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: You've got a lantern. Good. A lantern is how you tell the dark what matters.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: But light doesn't swing back. For that...
[i]He sets a feather on the anvil and takes the hammer to its nib. Four clean strikes. No bending.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: A Quill. Not a sword. A sword ends things. This one rewrites them.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Go on. Hit the dummy. Three times. Don't think about whether it's pretty.
Received: Garrick's Quill
[i]You hold out the sword.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Lorem Ipsum
nodes.text: Lorem. Ip-- ...

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: That's not a horseshoe.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: I made this when I was sixteen. Bent the blade twice. The Author was kind enough to write that I got it right on the third try.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: I didn't forge it for a war. I forged it for Wren. My little sister. She was afraid of the dark.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: I told her a hero's sword makes the dark afraid of her.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Then the chapter ended. I got old. Nobody needed a hero anymore, so I told myself horseshoes were enough.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Funny. I forgot I ever loved it. Not the sword. The making.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Thank you, little scribble. You didn't have to find it. You aren't even in the story.
[i]You are in the story now.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Hm. Colors. I'd forgotten about those, too.

nodes.speaker: Garrick
nodes.text: Come find me when you're ready to learn. Swinging a sword is mostly knowing what you're swinging it for.
Restored: Garrick

nodes.speaker: Lorem Ipsum
nodes.text: Lorem... ipsum...
[i]The frozen flame in his forge is still waiting. Touch it.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Lorem Ipsum
nodes.text: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...

nodes.speaker: Lorem Ipsum
nodes.text: ...consectetur. Horseshoe? Horseshoe.
[i]He is not a person right now. He is a placeholder holding a hammer.[/i]
[i]But the forge behind him is holding something, too. Its fire is frozen in a single moment. He cannot let go of it, and he cannot remember it.[/i]
